value.rationale: The result gives a natural exact structure theorem for every connected Cartesian product, reducing all matching multicuts to unique single-coordinate pullbacks. Explicit path and cycle one-dimensional formulas, with nontrivial Stirling and chromatic numbers, determine the full joint k-block/crossing-edge distribution in every dimension; this is substantially stronger than existence or optimum size and is motivated by active matching-multicut enumeration and complexity questions.
